item.title: Wednesday 10 AM Update, Nov 18
item.description:
The Wednesday 10 a.m. update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 18, 2026: Londonderry, New Hampshire weather through tomorrow morning; Mary Peltola wins Alaska's Senate race and House Democrats pick their leaders; Homeland Security Secretary Mullin faces questions on the outages; Poland says it headed off a Russian false-flag plot; Trump and Putin shake hands in Shenzhen as Canada and China ease tariffs; Saudi-led strikes on the Houthis; stocks wobble after Fed Governor Waller floats a half-point hike, and Nvidia halts licensed chip sales to China; Waymo pulls robotaxis off all US freeways; a GAO test gets chatbots to plan attacks; a flash-chip attack on Windows PINs and a rebuilt Chinese spy tool; your X feed; Londonderry's legal budget and Lightfest in Derry; and Antarctic blue whales bounce back. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
